brinkmann paul

architect

i build.

pure

system for man
physical control

every man knows the moment: the hand reaches for the phone, the fridge, the release. physical control starts exactly there. orgasm without losing your energy. an ice bath where everything in you screams to get out — and you stay. a training method that starts below your resistance, so you never want to stop. your body stops being the master. it becomes the instrument.

understanding the mind

dopamine is not your reward system. it's your anticipation system — and porn, weed, nicotine and endless scrolling all drain the same tank. that's why the world turns grey. every impulse is a wave: it rises, peaks and fades if you don't feed it. name it. ride it one minute longer. that minute is where a new man is built.

responsibility

responsibility is not a burden. it's power. one question changes every situation: where was i fully responsible? boundaries you announce mean nothing — boundaries you live mean everything. your word becomes your currency. you stop searching for the right woman and become the right man. this is how you lead — yourself first, then everyone who depends on you.

ego

the story you tell about yourself is a cage. who you have to be. what you have to defend. i found the exit eleven days in a buddhist monastery without a word or a glance, barefoot on a mountain, in my own breath. it's the same exit every time: the moment you feel that something is greater than you, the cage opens. call it god. call it the universe. the name doesn't matter.

mysidibou

unesco project

protect a place. build its future.

mysidibou is a project for sidi bou saïd, a beautiful village in tunisia. the vision: a cleaner village and a long-term approach to protecting its hillside setting for the generations that follow.

the plan connects daily litter collection and plastic reduction with architecture, the local community and students. an art café and art sales are intended to help fund the work and establish a responsibility that continues across generations.

focus: heritage · public space · community · students

kefir

probiotics · immunity · microbiome

a small culture. a daily ritual.

living kefir grains and a simple guide to making milk kefir at home. the grains are a reusable culture: after fermentation, they are separated from the drink and used for the next batch.

after years of experimenting, i developed a simple method for a mild kefir that fits easily into a daily routine. the vision is simple: make real homemade kefir easy enough that more people actually drink it every day.

includes: living grains · getting-started guide

souralf

your living sourdough

flour. water. time.

an active sourdough starter for baking bread at home. a starter is a culture maintained with flour and water, used to ferment dough and kept for future bakes.

feeding instructions and a first-loaf guide give you a starting point for building your own baking routine. get in touch for current availability.

includes: starter · feeding instructions · first-loaf guide

wim hof weekends

poland · november & december

a weekend in poland. small group. real practice.

join me in november or december at the original wim hof house in poland. in a small group of 20–25 people, we breathe, face the cold, climb śnieżka, cook together and spend the evenings around the fire.

i also share what years of personal experimentation have taught me about kefir, sourdough, the microbiome and the routines that helped me manage my own chronic inflammatory joint condition. this is personal experience, not a promise to cure disease.

the idea is simple: a few intense days of practice, food, conversation and shared experience. places are limited.

november & december · poland · 20–25 people

neuroarchitecture

phd in progress

design for the person inside the space.

my phd in progress explores the relationship between architecture and human experience. the question: how can the spaces we inhabit be designed with the people using them in mind?

light, spatial proportions and materials are central themes in this enquiry. it connects my background in architecture with an interest in perception, behaviour and wellbeing.

focus: architecture · perception · human experience
